title: Annotated Chest Radiograph of Acute Cardiogenic Pulmonary Edema
author: Mikael Häggström
caption: Annotated chest radiograph demonstrating cardiomegaly, upper lobe pulmonary venous diversion, Kerley B lines, and alveolar edema from acute left ventricular pump failure.
alt_text: Annotated frontal chest X-ray showing enlarged cardiac silhouette and pulmonary vascular congestion.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates pulmonary congestion and acute cardiac pump failure findings associated with cardiogenic shock (CLIFF-012, p.1, p.5-6).
